findings.title: Wage, Stipend, and Livelihood
findings.claim: Across the declared pericope, the focus's accepted striving is made legible as work whose return passes into continuing provision, livelihood, and personal sustenance.
findings.mechanism: The focus form سَعْيِهَا meets the supplied work, deprivation, food, and running-provision context at 88:3, 88:6, and 88:12. The named wage, livelihood, and continuing-provision branches turn the satisfaction relation into a compensation process in which effort has an ongoing return.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus's satisfaction can be perceived as satisfaction with a sustaining return, so work and livelihood form one connected movement rather than isolated mentions.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains satisfaction with her striving. The packet supports a local pericope compensation image, not a claim about every instance of these roots or a wider surah-wide system.

epistemic.reason: Trusted channel evidence names every branch, gives exact pericope anchor ayahs, and supplies a connected work-to-compensation relation; the contextual carriers are still limited to the supplied surface evidence.

findings.title: d02_efficacy_not_exhaustion
findings.claim: Within the declared pericope, 88:9's satisfaction evaluates the fruitfulness of striving alongside the contrast between exhausting labor and provision that leaves hunger unsatisfied.
findings.mechanism: The supplied sequence pairs the working and exhausting forms at 88:3 with the 88:7 failure to nourish or suffice, then returns to سَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ. This independent contrast makes the focus's accepted striving outcome-bearing rather than satisfied merely because exertion occurred.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive satisfaction as related to an effective result, while the ordinary sense of being pleased with one's striving remains available.
findings.containment: The primary reading remains satisfaction with her striving. The attributed contrast does not prove that efficacy is the only criterion; the supplied alternative that labor is rewarded or punished independently remains live. Non-focus morphology is not supplied.
